info.name: Ecommerce Seller Panel API
info.description: Seller-panel-only API collection organized in the canonical seller sidebar order: Dashboard, My Finance & Payouts, My Reports, Catalog, Inventory, Invoices, Marketing, Orders, and Shipping. Authentication, onboarding, profile, organizations, and access APIs are grouped separately because they sit outside sidebar navigation. Includes 136 requests. Regenerate with: npm run postman:seller
